appearance_facts.fact: A single blue line connects ten black circular markers, one per year from 2005 to 2014, showing a generally downward trend.
The leftmost marker is at the top of the series, labeled 23.9°C, and is the highest point on the line.
The rightmost marker is at the bottom of the series, labeled 10.1°C, and is the lowest point on the line.
Markers for 2006-2013 descend in value from 23.9°C to 11.3°C, with a small rise from 2010 (15.5°C) to 2011 (15.3°C) being a slight decrease, not an increase.

public_definitions: Review the cooling water temperature dashboard for the 2005-2014 review period, determine whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up, then submit the appropriate routing decision.
Use the dashboard to determine whether the full-period cooling water temperature change should enter substantial-change follow-up or remain in routine monitoring.
Routing criterion: Whether the full-period cooling water temperature change requires substantial-change follow-up
uncertain: No explicit numerical threshold or policy table is shown on the page defining what magnitude of change constitutes 'substantial-change follow-up' versus 'routine monitoring for ordinary variation' or 'archive and background filing'.
